about:
NDH Medical Inc is a contract medical device manufacturer based in St. Petersburg, Florida. The company was founded in 1999 and operates as a privately held business. Its facility at 11001 Roosevelt Boulevard North houses extrusion, molding, and assembly operations under one roof.

The company specializes in custom extrusion of medical tubing, including single-lumen, multi-lumen, coextruded, taper (bump), braid-reinforced, and wire/coil jacketing configurations. It also provides insert molding, injection molding, pad printing, assembly, and in-house tooling design and fabrication. Product development services and full contract manufacturing programs are offered alongside extrusion capabilities.

NDH Medical serves medical device manufacturers, supplying components and single-use devices for a range of clinical applications. The company works with customers from early product development through to volume production, though specific client names are not disclosed.

The company emphasizes vertical integration, with in-house tooling design and fabrication supporting its extrusion and molding operations. It also highlights participation in major medical device trade shows as part of its market engagement.
